caption: The Upload media window
preconditions: Seeded newsroom (SEED.md); desk 'Culture' exists
A picture content profile exists (Settings > Content Profiles, Content Type Picture) with Headline and Description required, so required markers show; otherwise the default media fields show

steps.script: (async () => { const mk = (name, hue) => new Promise((res) => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 1600; c.height = 1067; const g = c.getContext('2d'); const grd = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 1600, 1067); grd.addColorStop(0, 'hsl(' + hue + ',60%,60%)'); grd.addColorStop(1, 'hsl(' + (hue + 40) + ',60%,30%)'); g.fillStyle = grd; g.fillRect(0, 0, 1600, 1067); c.toBlob((b) => res(new File([b], name, {type: 'image/jpeg'})), 'image/jpeg', 0.9); }); const files = await Promise.all([mk('festival-opening-1.jpg', 200), mk('festival-opening-2.jpg', 25), mk('festival-opening-3.jpg', 140)]); const dt = new DataTransfer(); files.forEach((f) => dt.items.add(f)); document.querySelector('[data-test-id="file-upload"] [data-test-id="drag-area"]').dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('drop', {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer: dt})); })()

steps: Wait until [data-test-id="file-upload"] contains at least one [data-test-id="media-grid-item"]
Change the headline in [data-test-id="media-metadata-editor"] [data-test-id="field--headline"] to 'Harbour Lights Festival opening night'
Change the headline in [data-test-id="media-metadata-editor"] [data-test-id="field--description_text"] to 'Crowds gather on the quay for the opening concert of the Harbour Lights Festival.'

steps.script: (() => { const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-test-id="file-upload"] *')].find((x) => x.children.length === 0 && /Currently editing/.test(x.textContent)); let p = el && el.parentElement; while (p && !(p.scrollHeight > p.clientHeight + 4 && getComputedStyle(p).overflowY !== 'visible')) { p = p.parentElement; } if (p) { p.scrollTop = 0; } })()

notes: Upload window: scripts/apps/archive/views/upload.html inside sd-multi-image-edit (scripts/apps/search/views/multi-image-edit.html). Header: 'Upload media', Cancel, 'Send to: Culture' desk dropdown ([data-test-id=upload-selected-desk]), Upload. Thumbnails with Select All / Deselect All, Metadata panel with 'Currently editing: 3 items' and Copy metadata / Paste metadata at the bottom. capture.mjs has no file-input action, so the evaluate step draws three gradient JPEGs on a canvas and dispatches a drop on the drag area, the same way the e2e MediaUpload.dropFiles does. If the drop is ignored, add a setInputFiles action to capture.mjs and use [data-test-id=image-upload-input] with real photos. Cancel in cleanup so nothing is uploaded. Capture: filling the description scrolls the Metadata panel down; an evaluate step scrolls it back to the top so 'Currently editing: 3 items' shows.

notes: Media field markup in scripts/apps/authoring/views/article-edit.html: overlay icons edit-metadata (pencil), edit-image (switches), crop (crop icon, only when crop sizes exist), label 'Original (W x H px)', metadata view and crop thumbnails (sd-item-crops) below. Hover must keep the overlay visible at capture time. Capture: the hover goes to the overlay block ([data-test-id=image-overlay-actions]); the icons in the centre of the picture intercept a hover on media-image and Playwright times out. 1200 px high so the picture, its size label and the crops fit without scrolling. The hover state is lost by the time the shot is taken (the overlay is opacity 0 unless .item-association is hovered), so a style pins the overlay at opacity 1, which is exactly what the hover shows. The style lives only in this page load.
